useWhen: An operator hands over a CircleCI config.yml and asks whether it is valid, which jobs a branch or tag runs and in what order, or hands over run records or JUnit reports and asks what fails or flakes
avoidWhen: Running jobs, triggering or cancelling pipelines, reading from circleci.com or a VCS, or presenting kumitate's plan as CircleCI's own result

inputs.config: the config.yml text the operator provided
inputs.pipeline: branch or tag, and pipeline parameter values the operator agreed to
inputs.runs: downloaded API v2 JSON or kumitate.runs.v1

outputs.plan: validity with named reasons, the jobs that run by level, skipped jobs with reasons, and optional processed YAML, API v2 shapes or local steps
outputs.summary: failed, flaky and slow jobs and tests

authority.binding: caller authorization; the mcp server must be started by its owner and enabled in the profile

validation.runtime: protocol-tested 2026-10-23: tools/list and tools/call over Streamable HTTP with the itonami-agent HTTP MCP client (kotoba-lang/itonami-agent 0c05574) on fixture input; no model-driven agent turn, no deployed profile

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only. The steps call MCP tools by their itonami-agent names (mcp__<server>__<tool>) and assume the server key in mcp_servers is kumitate.
